name: How to Get Espers!
storyline: Murphy can see a flying fist or a passing bullet as if time had stopped. There's just one problem: Murphy's body can't keep up. One ordinary day, an attempted kidnapping pulls Murphy into a string of incidents and into the path of Espers who are just a little bit stranger.
summary: An Esper who can see everything, stuck in a perfectly ordinary body. Your choices shape the incidents, the bonds and the ending in How to Get Espers, a superpower action visual novel and story game.
